text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant proteinuria, hematuria, leukocyturia, nitrites, bacteria, and markedly elevated E. coli in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection, likely with upper tract involvement. Low specific gravity may suggest impaired concentrating ability. Recommend clinical correlation for possible pyelonephritis and assessment of renal function. Prompt antimicrobial therapy and further evaluation are advised.
